content.text:
NAMES                            STATUS
audiominer-local-fs-watcher-1    Up 8 minutes
audiominer-local-web-service-1   Up 8 minutes
audiominer-local-asr-service-1   Up 8 minutes
audiominer-local-redis-1         Up 8 minutes
---
web 8090: 200
curl exit 0
admin 8091: 200
curl exit 0

observation.command: sleep 10; docker ps --format 'table {{.Names}}\t{{.Status}}'; echo "---"; curl -sS -m 15 -o /dev/null -w "web 8090: %{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:8090/ ; echo "curl exit $?"; curl -sS -m 15 -o /dev/null -w "admin 8091: %{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:8091/ ; echo "curl exit $?"
